title: Database connection pool exhaustion cascading to API services
resolution: Raised the pool size and shipped a fix for a leaked connection in the order service.

title: Cache memory pressure causing evictions and slow reads
resolution: Scaled the cache node up and set a TTL on the unbounded session keys.

title: API memory leak leading to restarts
resolution: Rolled back the release that introduced the leak, then patched the buffer that was never released.

title: Gateway rate limiting after a traffic spike
resolution: Raised the gateway quota and added client-side backoff for the noisy caller.

title: Storage volume filling up on a data node
resolution: Expanded the volume and added a retention policy for the rotating log directory.
